title: Technology’s trust boundary is moving
summary: The week’s technology stories share a common fault line: software is becoming more connected, more automated and more consequential, while the old boundaries of trust are proving porous. A compromised service credential reportedly opened access across many Microsoft 365 tenants; AI systems are being discussed as software buyers; and regulators are taking a harder look at platform power. None of these developments is isolated. They describe a market where identity, procurement and competition policy increasingly meet in the same operational layer. The winners will need...
